Name: Pastel Goth Cat
Author: GraceTheChicken
Description:
With this pastel goth cat you can spruce up your old cat!

[b][u]Installation[/u]
[/b]1. Unzip the file.
2. Navigate to your [code]Stardew Valley\Content\Animals[/code] folder.
3. Drag and drop the new cat.xnb file into the folder, and replace it.
4. Start Stardew Valley and enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Replace the old cat with this new pastel goth version!
